frozen_background: Only analytic GE06 GR+AeST+GE05 sector, with no ordinary species, at relaxed FLRW: 3H²=Q*K_Q-K (H²=rho_A). For general cosmology, separately include ordinary matter and its perturbations. k>0 and a>0.

frozen_field_dictionary.metric: N=1+Psi, L=R=a(1-Phi), ADM spatial b varied then b=0 Newtonian gauge
frozen_field_dictionary.fluid: rho_A=(Q*K_Q-K)/3; delta rho_A=(Q*K_QQ deltaQ-k²(K_B E_A+C chi)/a²)/3; T_A=(rho_A+p_A)*k² varphi/(aQ)

frozen_action_constraints.linear_momentum: E_b^(1)=4*i*k*a³*(Phi_dot+H*Psi-K_Q*varphi/2), no direct linear bath shift source
frozen_action_constraints.linear_hamiltonian_offshell: E_N^(1)|b=0 +4a³*[k² Phi/a²+3H(Phi_dot+H Psi)+3 delta rho_A/2] +6a³ Phi*[3H²-(Q*K_Q-K)] =0
frozen_action_constraints.class_hamiltonian_on_background: k² Phi+(3/2)a²[delta rho_A+3(aH/k²) T_A]=0 upon momentum constraint

full_physics_LIMIT: Full 3+1 scalar+vector+tensor constraints with Y-sector and ordinary species, unit-aether / auxiliary Lagrange multipliers, all E_phi/E_u source rows and gauge mapping still OPEN; do not infer physical eta Weyl observer.
